categories.title: Monster Nest
categories.info:
Nests are localized infestations of a single monster type. Destroy the nests with Grapeshot, Dancing Star, or Samum bombs. Often, a stronger "boss" variation of the monster will spawn after the nest is destroyed, which can be killed for bonus XP rewards.


**Rewards:**
- 20 XP
- Random Nest Loot

categories.title: Beehive
categories.info:
Honeycomb looted from beehives are very useful for their unusually high sell price with herbalists in White Orchard and Velen. It can be a great source of early game currency.

Use Aard or Igni to clear the bee swarm, then loot the fallen beehive for x1-4 Honeycomb. Beehives can respawn, but the honeycomb inside can only be looted once.

locations.title: Devil by the Well
locations.description:
_Warning: Unavailable after starting On Thin Ice (Main Quest, Act III)._

**Quest Giver:** Odolan or [Notice Board](https://mapgenie.io/witcher-3/maps/white-orchard?locationIds=19419)

**Level:** 2

Malicious beings usually haunt the ruins of castles, fortresses or, as a last resort, towers. The wraith of White Orchard, however, chose a much more quotidian site for its haunting: a well. A White Orchard peasant by the name of Odolan wanted someone to chase off the phantom and Geralt accepted the job.

**Rewards:**
- Kill Contract & Accept Reward
    - 50 XP
    - 20 x Crowns
- Kill Contract & Refuse Reward
    - 50 XP
    - Amethyst

_Note: After completing the contract, speak to [Tomira](https://mapgenie.io/witcher-3/maps/white-orchard?locationIds=19417) for additional rewards._

locations.title: Lilac and Gooseberries
locations.description:
[Next](https://mapgenie.io/witcher-3/maps/white-orchard?locationIds=180893)

**Level:** 1

_Yennefer had contacted Geralt—finally. They had not seen each other in years. And then she'd sent him a letter, smelling of lilac and gooseberries, of course, asking him to meet her in the village of Willoughby. "About a matter of great importance," she had written._

**Rewards:**
- 250 XP

locations.title: The Incident in White Orchard
locations.description:
[Next](https://mapgenie.io/witcher-3/maps/vizima-palace?locationIds=555352) | [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/witcher-3/maps/white-orchard?locationIds=180893)

**Level:** 2

_While searching for Yennefer, Geralt and Vesemir stopped by the tavern in the village of White Orchard. When a row erupted in the establishment soon afterwards, Vesemir decided to defend the besieged innkeep._

**Rewards:**
- 300 XP

locations.title: The Beast of White Orchard
locations.description:
[Next](https://mapgenie.io/witcher-3/maps/white-orchard?locationIds=180892) | [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/witcher-3/maps/white-orchard?locationIds=20373)

**Level:** 2

The commander of the Nilfgaardian garrison in White Orchard knew where Yennefer had gone. Shrewdly, he was unwilling to share this information for free. A man with substantial experience, he knew full well Geralt would do anything to find the sorceress. As luck would have it, there was a griffin about, a beast the commander's soldiers had been unable to hunt down. The commander could demand but one thing: the monster's head in exchange for his help.

**Rewards:**
- 300 XP

locations.title: A Frying Pan, Spick and Span
locations.description:
_Warning: Unavailable after Geralt leaves for Vizima at the end of [Lilac and Gooseberries](https://mapgenie.io/witcher-3/maps/white-orchard?locationIds=20373)._

**Guest Giver:** Old Woman

**Level:** N/A

_Many think that the life of a witcher consists of nothing but adventure after grand adventure, an endless stream of contracts on manticores, bruxae and other exotic beasts. In truth, Geralt would often take on more banal tasks, ones lesser bards fear mentioning, for they lack the skill required to make a masterwork of the mundane. By way of example, once in White Orchard he was hired to retrieve a woman's... frying pan._

**Rewards:**
- 10 XP
- Baked Apple x5
- Bread x5
- Apple Juice x5

locations.title: Precious Cargo
locations.description:
_Warning: Unavailable after Geralt leaves for Vizima at the end of [Lilac and Gooseberries](https://mapgenie.io/witcher-3/maps/white-orchard?locationIds=20373)._

**Guest Giver:** Forlorn Merchant

**Level:** N/A

The merchant Geralt found standing by the side of the road in White Orchard was extremely distraught. He had been hauling some precious goods to the Nilfgaardian camp when his horse spooked and veered off the road, pulling the merchant's cart with it and dumping the whole works in the foggy swamp outside the camp.

**Rewards:**
- Let Merchant Go & Keep Box
    - 10 XP
    - 50 x Crowns
    - 5 x Celandine
    - 4 x White Myrtle
- Let Merchant Go & Return Box
    - 10 XP
    - 30 x Crowns
- Turn In Merchant
    - 10 XP
    - 30 x Crowns

locations.title: Twisted Firestarter
locations.description:
_Warning: Unavailable after Geralt leaves for Vizima at the end of [Lilac and Gooseberries](https://mapgenie.io/witcher-3/maps/white-orchard?locationIds=20373)._

**Guest Giver:** [Willis](https://mapgenie.io/witcher-3/maps/white-orchard?locationIds=19459) or [Notice Board](https://mapgenie.io/witcher-3/maps/white-orchard?locationIds=19419)

**Level:** N/A

There were only a handful of nonhumans in White Orchard. One of them was the dwarf Willis, an excellent blacksmith whose wares attracted peasants from far and wide. Sadly, his forge had burned to the ground shortly before Geralt arrived. Willis suspected the fire had been started deliberately and asked the witcher to investigate this alleged arson.

**Rewards:**
- 50 XP
- 20 x Crowns
- Unlocks Blacksmith

locations.title: Missing in Action
locations.description:
_Warning: Unavailable after Geralt leaves for Vizima at the end of [Lilac and Gooseberries](https://mapgenie.io/witcher-3/maps/white-orchard?locationIds=20373)._

**Guest Giver:** Dune or [Notice Board](https://mapgenie.io/witcher-3/maps/white-orchard?locationIds=19419): "Brother Missing"

**Level:** N/A

Geralt was far from the only person in White Orchard looking for a lost loved one. War had divided many families, including that of a certain villager whose brother went missing after the last big battle.

**Rewards:**
- 25 XP
- 25 x Crowns

locations.title: On Death's Bed
locations.description:
_Warning: Unavailable after Geralt leaves for Vizima at the end of [Lilac and Gooseberries](https://mapgenie.io/witcher-3/maps/white-orchard?locationIds=20373)._

**Guest Giver:** [Tomira](https://mapgenie.io/witcher-3/maps/white-orchard?locationIds=19417)

**Level:** 2

_Once again Geralt had a near impossible choice to make—a choice between a greater and lesser evil. While preparing to hunt the griffin, he had come across one of the beast's victims—a simple peasant woman named Lena. She had been on her way to meet her lover when the griffin attacked. The beast had mortally wounded her. A witcher's potion could save her life... or cause her to perish in agony._

**Rewards:**
- 350 XP
- 50 x Crowns
- Formula: Cursed Oil
- Book: [Of Sweat and Blood](https://mapgenie.io/witcher-3/maps/white-orchard?locationIds=180895)

locations.title: Griffin Mutagen

locations.title: Crystal Skull
locations.description:
The Crystal Skull from the intro movie is found in the initial camp, and can be returned to Yennefer later in the game.

**NB:** Can't be picked up once you've completed the quest '[The Beast of White Orchard](https://mapgenie.io/witcher-3/maps/white-orchard?locationIds=180893)'.

locations.title: Ornate Bracelet
locations.description:
**Related Quest:** [Devil by the Well](https://mapgenie.io/witcher-3/maps/white-orchard?locationIds=19473) (Witcher Contract)

Underwater, within the cave. Accessible via the [underwater entrance](https://mapgenie.io/witcher-3/maps/white-orchard?locationIds=19452) in the nearby lake or by jumping into the [well](https://mapgenie.io/witcher-3/maps/white-orchard?locationIds=19451) at the center of the abandoned village.
